name: Passos no Escuro - Kung-Fu à Portuguesa
description: Cinema Passos Manuel hosts a screening session titled Passos no Escuro - Kung-Fu à Portuguesa.
longDescription:
Passos no Escuro - Kung-Fu à Portuguesa takes place at Cinema Passos Manuel on 2 December 2026, starting at 22:00. The session runs for 120 minutes and is promoted by Jardim das Coincidências Lda.

Tickets are priced at 7€, with Tripass discounts available. The event has an age rating of over 18 years.
